I – Daily Eating for Health and High Energy
13
Dietary Recommendations for Good Health
By following these dietary recommendations, you can
substantially reduce your risk of developing heart
disease and other diseases of aging.
• Balance calorie intake and physical activity to achieve
and maintain a healthy body weight.
• Consume a diet rich in vegetables and fruits.
• Choose whole-grain, high-fiber foods.
• Consume fish, especially oily fish, at least twice a week.
• Limit your intake of saturated fat to <7% of
energy, trans fat to <1% of energy, and cholesterol
to <300 mg per day by:
—choosing lean meats and vegetable alternatives.
—selecting fat-free (skim), 1%-fat, and low-fat
dairy products.
—minimizing intake of partially hydrogenated fats.
